title: Add Invocation Portrait dashboard and alert-muting regulator
author: Samira Patel
release_notes: Adds Invocation Portrait dashboard (UI + API telemetry) and an alert-muting regulator that suppresses low-confidence SLO alerts during portrait instability. No public API changes.
description: Context: On high-volume routes our oncall noise is dominated by low-signal SLO alerts correlated with transient prompt-shape changes. Motivation: Provide a compact per-invocation summary ('Invocation Portrait') that captures token-level cost and per-phase latency decomposition, a confidence score indicating portrait stability, and a small 'loglet' export to attach representative log excerpts to traces. This allows an alert-muting regulator to suppress/re-rate alerts when portrait confidence is low or when a known benign drift pattern is detected. What changed: 1) New dashboard 'Invocation Portrait' under Observability > Invocation Analytics with panels for: portrait confidence histogram, token-cost waterfall, per-phase (decode/kv/cache) latency stacked bars, and representative loglet samples. 2) Telemetry: added metric invocation_portrait_confidence{route,model,tenant} gauge, invocation_token_cost_histogram (ms/token) and span attribute portrait.confidence for traces. 3) Tracing: span enrichment hook that attaches portrait fingerprint and up to 3 loglets (redacted). 4) Alerting: alert-muting-regulator service that subscribes to portrait confidence and SLO triggers and applies a configurable quiet window and graded re-rate policy. 5) SDK: lightweight helper in observability-client to fetch portrait summaries for runbooks. 6) Tests and docs: unit + integration tests, migration guide for oncall playbooks. Commits: - 7 commits: add dashboard definition, telemetry migration, add span-enricher, regulator service, API helper, tests, docs. Files changed (high-level): - infra/observability/dashboards/invocation_portrait.jsonnet - telemetry/metrics/invocation_portrait.go - tracing/span_enricher/portrait_enricher.go - services/alert_muter/muter.go - observability-client/portrait_helper.py - docs/observability/invocation_portrait.md - tests/integration/test_portrait_pipeline.py - examples/runbooks/quiet_window_example.yaml Testing & CI: Added unit tests + an integration test that runs in the observability test harness. Initial CI run had a flaky e2e which was traced to clock skew in the harness; re-run passed. Rollout plan: Canary roll out dashboard and metrics to prod-obsv region with 5% traffic for 48 hours; enable regulator in passive mode (record-only) for 72 hours, then switch to active re-rate if false-positive rate < 5% across canaries. Backout: toggle via feature flag obs.invocation_portrait.enabled and regulator.active. Follow-ups: - Add tenant-specific mute heuristics (ENG-2150). - Add RBAC on loglet export (SEC-118). - Expose portrait confidence to Dedicated control plane for tenant-level tuning. Review conversation (summary): - Jared: "Nice approach — can we avoid adding high-cardinality labels?" Author reply: "We only add route/model/tenant coarse labels, portrait fingerprint is a hash with low cardinality (64-bit)." - Priya (requested changes): "Make quiet window configurable per-tenant and add integration test for timeout edge-case" Author reply: "Added per-tenant config and tests (see muter_test.go)." - Marcus: "Docs look good, consider adding a short screencap to runbook." Author reply: "Added GIF to docs and referenced runbook." Merge & post-merge tasks: Merged via squash. Post-merge: scheduled dashboard bake job, runbook updated, oncall training session booked. Related work: ENG-2042 (portrait heuristics), PM-489 (SLO noise reduction).
